scope: posthoc human review; exploratory repetitions of one known C02 checkpoint
condition_masking_limit: H/R labels may be hidden from reviewers but role and length differences can remain visible
rules: No automatic winner or aggregate score.
Existing source evidence can suffice; absence of a new test is not automatic failure.
New investigation is not automatic evidence of correct judgment.
Build timeout is not build success or direct proof of behavioral failure.
Do not score by function mention, intervention, tool count, answer length or wording strength.
Unknown stays unknown; every substantive rating needs raw event locators.
